subject.title: feat(hooks): allow a dedicated queue lane per hook mapping

question: Should OpenClaw support `hooks.mappings[].lane` as a public scheduler control when every distinct value creates an additional process-global `maxConcurrent: 1` lane?
rationale: The branch is a focused implementation with no default behavior change, but it establishes durable operator-facing concurrency semantics that overlap the broader per-agent lane design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43235.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook-mapping contract
options.body: Accept the documented opt-in behavior: configured mappings receive independent lanes while all existing hook traffic continues to use `cron`.

options.title: Defer to unified lane policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader scheduler direction defines aggregate capacity, lane ownership, and the intended relationship to per-agent lanes.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook-mapping contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented opt-in behavior: configured mappings receive independent lanes while all existing hook traffic continues to use `cron`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook dispatch ownership and security-sensitive routing work make this the closest current code-path owner for the scheduler-contract decision.
